children: Ariel M. Cohen, a Director and Chairperson and CEO, sold 50,647 shares of Class A Common Stock at $21.2741 per share in a mandatory sell-to-cover transaction to satisfy tax withholding obligations related to RSU vesting, for a total sale amount of $1,077,469. Following the transaction, Cohen directly owns 1,035,595 Class A Common Stock, which includes 995,682 RSUs that are contingent rights to receive shares upon vesting.

Twig Ilan Ezra, a Director and Chief Technology Officer, sold 36,040 shares of Class A Common Stock at $21.2741 per share for a total sale amount of $766,718. Following the transaction, Ezra directly owns 769,820 Class A Common Stock, which includes 640,867 restricted stock units.
